body:
Owner acceptance — FND-02 candidate selection and completion

I have reviewed the final criterion/maintenance report and accept
`fnd-02-json-nojpeg2000-proposal-4` (candidate revision 4, schema 1)
as the selected development candidate for the next AmbisGIS tasks.

Reviewed PR #68 head:
7c4c6a6ddbc364e520911e06b9a97a7c10bdcfcf

Merged checkpoint:
973a5ef383687cd00143c679f832cfb006a57cf0

Candidate manifest SHA-256:
0d7a61818d73ad27135f9bb0756797bd2c4f7e10c717d3536517534eca57cf99

WAR SHA-256:
90493ef3e96016bd150439d07b2e0adbcd2ec4292bd648f29c246e18422eebe1

My acceptance covers all four original FND-02 criteria:

C1: the recorded inspection and exact selection of the component sources,
versions, profiles and retained inputs.

C2: the accurate source/license finding record and evidenced variant-specific
remediations, with originals and remaining obligations preserved. This does
not waive third-party terms or clear excluded historical code for distribution.

C3: the bounded build and combination-test evidence, including its recorded
failures, exclusions and runtime limitations. I accept the Java/server
NO-ORACLE, headless-Temurin17 and NO-JPEG2000 profile: no Oracle-backed stores
or mosaic indexes, no renderer OpenGL path, and no JP2/raw J2K inputs,
JPEG2000 outputs or JPX-backed PDF inputs on the affected Java/server routes.
This is not a claim that the QGIS desktop or all other profiles are headless
or lack JPEG2000 capability. The other recorded profile limits remain explicit.

C4: AmbisGIS controls future source and release decisions. Upstream releases,
security disclosures and patches are inputs for deliberate review, not
automatic updates. Imports, backports and independent fixes require recorded
provenance, affected tests and a new manifest revision; known insecure versions
must not be frozen indefinitely without an appropriate response.

I accept completion of FND-02, including its internal F02-06, F02-07 and
F02-08 acceptance steps, within those original criteria. Codex may reconcile
issue #3, its Project Delivery state and completion records with this decision,
retaining the exact immutable candidate and linking this owner comment.

This does NOT accept the separate FND-03, FND-05, FND-07 or FND-08 tasks,
complete P0, authorize a release or production deployment, approve external
binary/source redistribution, or grant future PR merges. Residual source,
notice, security, licensing and operational obligations remain at their
explicitly recorded gates.
